⚙ Merge rules (for build): 1. Same CAGE typed in Add Vendor → always offer merge — it is the same entity. 2. New CAGE, company matches an existing vendor → offer "Add this CAGE to that record" or keep separate (member decides — some divisions really are separate vendors). 3. Manual merge: select two vendors (or click the duplicate chip) → pick the keeper, union CAGEs + RFQ history + quotes + awards, per-field conflict picker; blanks auto-fill from the other record. 4. My Vendors only — the shared Vendor Pool stays one row per CAGE (that's how the government data works).
